name: Dust of Disappearance

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Throw into the air
powers.text: Utilize action: you and each creature within 10 ft are Invisible for 2d4 minutes (it ends for a creature that attacks or casts a spell).

summary: Thrown in the air, it makes you and everyone within 10 ft Invisible for 2d4 minutes.
text: This fine, sand-like powder comes in a small packet holding a single dose. Toss it into the air with a Utilize action, and you and everything around you within 10 feet, creatures and objects alike, gain the Invisible condition, which lasts 2d4 minutes for all of them; the dust is used up as its magic takes hold. The moment an affected creature attacks, casts a spell or deals damage, its invisibility ends.
